candidates.snippet: 1558: Accession to the Throne - Elizabeth I ascended to the throne of England, beginning her long and influential reign. 1588: Defeat of the Spanish Armada - The English fleet, under Elizabeth's command, successfully repelled the Spanish Armada, a major turning point in English history. 1590: Golden Age of English Drama - The Elizabethan era saw a significant flourishing of English literature and drama, with playwrights like Shakespeare gaining prominence. 1603: Death of Elizabeth I - Queen Elizabeth I died, ending the Tudor dynasty and ushering in the Stuart era.
